none: PAS CAM-973CF7: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint unclear. AD335-341, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows 2 Soldiers, one Standard. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]. Condition worn, die axis 6 o'clock. Weight 1.78g, diameter 15.59mm
